name: Cult Closure
summary: A druid asks you to thin the Wild King's followers near the Well of Eternity. Their zeal is hindering efforts to tend Nordrassil and guard the Well.

sections.title: A Divided Oath
sections.body: A druid near the Well of Eternity sends you against Blackthorne Adepts and Wild-branded Cultists. They once shared oaths with the druids who tend Nordrassil, but now their zeal obstructs that work and threatens the Well. The land's defenders fear they may also strike when a greater incursion begins.

sections.title: A Hard Duty
sections.body: The fighting leaves the druid troubled. Druids have been forced to fight their own kind, and the hope is that the conflict can be settled soon.

faq.q: Who are the Wild King's followers?
faq.answer: They are followers of the Wild King who hinder efforts to tend Nordrassil and protect the Well of Eternity.

faq.q: Why are the druids fighting each other?
faq.answer: The Wild King's followers were once bound by the same oaths as the druids tending Nordrassil, but their zeal now hinders that work and threatens the Well.
